findings.title: LCP mobile excessif 4-8s vs cible 2.5s
findings.recommendation: Phase 1: Lenis disable mobile, GTM afterInteractive, Hero poster+preload, AddressAutocomplete lazy, favicon reduce

findings.title: JavaScript main thread énorme (3.5-3.8s)
findings.description: Home script eval 3.5s, bootup 3.8s. Trois chunks 1.7s+1.0s+0.6s. Lenis + RAF loop permanent.
findings.recommendation: Run @next/bundle-analyzer. Disable Lenis mobile. Lazy-load AddressAutocomplete.

findings.title: 4 titres trop longs (70-74 chars, troncature SERP)
lastmod batch timestamps (93 URLs identiques 2026-10-18T19:42:53Z)
findings.description: Git commit dates. Zone pages shared data.ts. Google ignores unreliable lastmod.
findings.recommendation: Per-page updatedAt field ou drop shared data.ts

findings.title: /references 207w (besoin 600w) — zéro clients nommés
findings.description: Proof page critique. Zéro testimonials. Impact trust + AIO.
findings.recommendation: Expand 207→600w, ajouter 3-5 case studies, logos, Review schema, AggregateRating

findings.title: 'Interlocuteur unique' toujours dans og:description + LocalBusiness
findings.description: Commit cee9d6c l'a changé en 'Marchandise assurée' partout sauf meta/schema.

findings.title: openingHours format ancien (besoin openingHoursSpecification)
findings.description: Legacy format. Modern prefer array avec dayOfWeek.

findings.title: Brand mentions tiers TRÈS faibles (Wikidata only)
findings.description: No Wikipedia, Reddit, YouTube, LinkedIn. Biggest gap for AI citations.
findings.recommendation: Build GBP, LinkedIn, YouTube. Add to sameAs. Aim 10+ reviews.

findings.title: Publication dates incorrectes (2014, 2026-01-01 vs fondation 2026-02-21)
findings.recommendation: Fix datePublished: 2026-10-18+, add dateModified, visible 'Mis à jour' date

findings.title: Cannibalisation: 6 URLs fight 'coursier paris' + 'prix'
findings.recommendation: Pick 1 owner per query. Consolidate or differentiate.

findings.title: Zone titles use landmarks vs commercial hooks
findings.description: 'Coursier Poissy 78300 - Villa Savoye' vs 'Coursier Montreuil 93100 : dès 21€'.

findings.title: E-commerce page weak (52/100 persona score)
findings.description: H1 'Coursier jour' bizarre. No price. No API/Shopify.
findings.recommendation: Rename 'Livraison same-day e-commerce'. Add price, API sections, CTA.

findings.title: Doorway-page risk: 125 zones = 85%, bulk-indexed 18 oct
findings.description: isZoneIndexed() hard-coded true. 125 > 50-page threshold. Bulk-index pattern penalized.
findings.recommendation: Verify 60%+ unique content. Prepare noindex if GSC shows 'Crawled, not indexed' spike.
